_readme: Why each funded company is, or is not, in the neurotech set.
The rule, from docs/funding-chart-audit.md: companies whose primary product
interfaces with, measures, or modulates the nervous system. Includes implanted
and external neuromodulation devices, brain-computer interfaces, neurological
diagnostic and imaging software, and prescription digital therapeutics for
neurological or psychiatric indications. Excludes companies developing drugs
for neurological indications, and general-purpose platforms not specific to
the nervous system.
Every entry is grounded in a record this database already holds. `evidence`
names which one: `description` is the organizations.description text,
`fda_device` is a linked openFDA clearance, and `company_site` is the
company's own product page, read where the stored description was too thin
to decide on. Nothing here is written from memory of the company.
The rule turns on what the product interfaces with, not what disease it
treats. That is why Setpoint Medical (vagus nerve stimulation for autoimmune
disease) and Axon Therapies (splanchnic nerve ablation for heart failure) are
both in: each modulates a nerve. Applying it by indication instead would
exclude both, and would be a different rule than the one agreed.
Applied by scripts/backfill-inclusion.js. Excluded companies get no
inclusion_basis, which is what keeps them off the chart.

Neuralink.basis: Fully implanted 1024-electrode array recording cortical activity for paralysis. Interfaces directly with the nervous system.

Setpoint Medical.basis: Implanted vagus nerve stimulator. Modulates the nervous system; the autoimmune indication does not change what the device interfaces with.

NeuroPace.basis: Implanted responsive neurostimulator for epilepsy. Records cortical activity and stimulates to interrupt seizures.

Ceribell.basis: FDA-cleared rapid EEG system measuring cortical electrical activity at the bedside without a technologist.

Cognito Therapeutics.basis: Non-invasive sensory gamma stimulation targeting neural oscillations in neurodegenerative disease.

Saluda Medical.basis: Closed-loop spinal cord stimulator that measures evoked compound action potentials and adjusts stimulation to them.

Science Corporation.basis: Retinal prosthesis and implanted neural interfaces.

Pear Therapeutics.basis: FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutics for psychiatric indications, named explicitly by the inclusion rule.

Precision Neuroscience.basis: Thin-film surface microelectrode array placed on the cortex, designed to be minimally invasive and reversible.

Onward Medical.basis: Targeted spinal cord stimulation restoring movement and function after spinal cord injury.

Merge Labs.basis: Brain-computer interface company developing high-bandwidth neural interfaces.

Nalu Medical.basis: Implanted peripheral nerve stimulator for pain relief. FDA 510(k) cleared 2019, product code GZF.

iSchemaView, Inc..basis: RAPID brain tissue imaging platform for stroke triage. Neurological imaging software.

Blackrock Neurotech.basis: Utah-array intracortical recording systems, with the longest track record of human BCI implants.

MicroTransponder.basis: Vagus nerve stimulation paired with rehabilitation, for tinnitus and stroke recovery.

Neuros Medical.basis: High-frequency nerve block system for chronic post-amputation pain.

ShiraTronics.basis: Implanted neuromodulation system for chronic migraine.

Cala Health.basis: Wrist-worn transcutaneous afferent patterned stimulation for essential tremor.

Axonics Modulation Technologies.basis: Implantable neuromodulation for overactive bladder and chronic pain, licensed from the Alfred Mann Foundation.

Axon Therapies.basis: Ablates the greater splanchnic nerve. Modulates the nervous system; cardiac indication, same reasoning as Setpoint Medical.

Paradromics.basis: High-data-rate intracortical microelectrode array aimed at restoring communication.

Synchron.basis: Endovascular stent-electrode array recording motor cortex activity via the jugular vein.

Autonomic Technologies.basis: Miniaturized implanted neurostimulation for severe headache.

Beacon Biosignals.basis: EEG analytics platform measuring neural activity for neurological and psychiatric drug development.

SPR Therapeutics.basis: Percutaneous peripheral nerve stimulation for pain.

NeuSpera Medical.basis: Miniaturized implanted neuromodulation using mid-field powering.

Neural Analytics.basis: Robotic transcranial ultrasound measuring cerebral blood flow to detect and track brain-health disorders.

Kernel.basis: Wearable time-domain fNIRS headset measuring brain activity non-invasively.

INBRAIN Neuroelectronics.basis: Graphene-based neural interface for high-resolution recording and stimulation.

Nia Therapeutics.basis: Implanted neural interface for memory restoration after brain injury.

PhotoPharmics.basis: Celeste photo-neuromodulation device delivering specialized light through retinal pathways for Parkinson's disease. Non-invasive, but it modulates a neural pathway.

MedRhythms.basis: Prescription rhythmic auditory stimulation (InTandem, MOVIVE) for gait rehabilitation after stroke and in Parkinson's disease.

Blue Note Therapeutics.basis: Prescription digital therapeutics for psychiatric indications, named explicitly by the inclusion rule.

ImThera Medical Inc.basis: Implanted hypoglossal nerve stimulator for obstructive sleep apnea. Modulates a nerve; the sleep indication does not change what the device interfaces with.

Linus Health.basis: Digital cognitive assessment platform measuring cognitive function through digitized clock-drawing, speech and gait tests.

Rune Labs.basis: StrivePD platform measuring Parkinson's motor state from wearable and deep brain stimulation data. FDA 510(k) cleared, K213519.

BRAINBox Solutions.basis: Traumatic brain injury diagnostic pairing blood biomarkers with tablet-based neurocognitive testing. The neurocognitive half measures nervous system function directly.

Mindstrong.basis: Digital biomarkers deriving continuous objective measures of cognition and mood. Included on the measurement platform, not on the virtual care arm.

Greatbatch.reason: Contract manufacturer of components and batteries for implantable devices, sold to OEMs across cardiac and neuro. A supplier of parts, not a company with a nervous-system product.

Silk Road Medical.reason: Transcarotid devices for arterial disease. A blood-vessel device; same reasoning as Conformal Medical and MIVI Neuroscience.

Tenax Therapeutics.reason: Therapeutics maintaining tissue oxygen supply. Nothing in the record describes a product that interfaces with, measures, or modulates the nervous system.

Tengion.reason: Regenerative neo-organs from autologous cells. The lead product is a neo-bladder; the neurogenic-bladder indication is downstream of a neurological condition, not an interface with the nervous system.

Cerebral.reason: Telehealth mental-health service with online medication management. Care delivery and prescribing. No product that interfaces with, measures, or modulates the nervous system.

MIVI Neuroscience.reason: Neurointerventional catheters for stroke procedures. A blood-vessel device. Same reasoning as Conformal Medical: treating a neurological event is not interfacing with the nervous system.

Artio Medical.reason: Endovascular occlusion devices for cerebral aneurysms and peripheral vascular disease. A blood-vessel device, and the peripheral indications make it not nervous-system specific.

Impel NeuroPharma.reason: Nose-to-brain drug delivery device. It exists to deliver drugs for neurological indications, which the rule excludes. The device does not itself measure or modulate the nervous system.

NeuroFlow.reason: Behavioral-health care-coordination platform for providers. Workflow and engagement software. It tracks patients, not the nervous system.

Atomwise.reason: AI drug-discovery platform. Excluded twice over: it develops drugs, and it is a general-purpose discovery platform not specific to the nervous system.

Conformal Medical.reason: Left atrial appendage closure to prevent stroke in atrial fibrillation. A cardiac device. Preventing a neurological event is not interfacing with the nervous system.

Elucid Bioimaging.reason: Cardiovascular plaque imaging software. Neither the imaging target nor the indication is neurological.

Cell Point.reason: Molecular imaging agents for oncology, cardiology, stroke and diabetes. A general imaging-agent platform, not nervous-system specific.

Octave Bioscience.reason: Blood-based molecular diagnostics for multiple sclerosis. Measures biomarkers of a neurological disease rather than the nervous system itself. The closest call in this file; flip it if diagnostics for neurological disease should count.
